item.title: Melatonin 0.1.10
item.description:
Melatonin 0.1.10

  • T3 Code now shows up. 0.1.9 couldn't see the Claude Code that T3 Code starts, so T3 Code never counted as working. It now does, including while it waits on the model.
  • Claude Code from the native installer is recognized. Claude Code installed with its own installer runs under its version number, so Melatonin only noticed it through its transcripts. Its activity now counts right away.
